exposure: substance use disorder diagnoses (cannabis use disorder, opioid use disorder, alcohol use disorder, other drug use disorder)
outcome: any SUD diagnosis during delivery hospitalizations
cohort: The study included delivery hospitalizations for women aged 15-54 years with substance use disorder diagnoses identified from the 2000-2018 National Inpatient Sample.
finding: Substance use disorders (SUDs) broadly increased across all demographic categories from 2000 to 2018, with higher increases in rural hospitals, younger maternal age groups, and lower income quartiles, and cannabis and opioid use disorders were associated with increased adjusted risks for adverse maternal outcomes such as preterm delivery, abruption, hemorrhage, and non-transfusion severe maternal morbidity.
